## 8d45a1d4a531

**Reproduced test-portability defect; no generator-semantic defect found.** The
current generator battery has 10 green stages, two nonblocking advisories
(profile/semantic hooks absent), and no failed stage. Its rule smoke, structural
self-check, exact overrides, diversity, authority sync, and Racket checks all
passed. Evidence:
`checks/audit-8d45a1d4a531-r2/checks/8d45a1d4a531_before_battery_summary.json`.

However, the required task-test snapshot fails 1 of 10 tests. The failing test
constructs the canonical-data path relative to the generator directory and
tries to read
`generators/8d45a1d4a531/data/canonical/puzzles.jsonl`; the portable runtime
places canonical data under its shared data root. Result: 9 passed, 1 failed with
`FileNotFoundError`. Evidence:
`checks/audit-8d45a1d4a531-task-tests/result.json`. The task should use the
portable `reviewer_support.canonical_pairs`/`find_root` helper. No source was
changed because this was an audit-only target.
